title: Kottbusser Tor - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **What Kotti is:** the Kottbusser Tor junction in Kreuzberg, where the U1 and U3 run on a viaduct and the U8 runs underneath.
**Reputation vs numbers:** police counted 4,067 offences in the hotspot area in 2024 and 3,091 in 2025 up to 19 November.
**Knife ban:** a weapons and knife ban zone covers the square and the station since 15 February 2025; knife attacks there fell from 48 to 26.
**The NKZ:** the curved 1974 block over Adalbertstraße, just under 300 flats, owned by the city company Gewobag since 2017.
**Police post:** the Kotti-Wache on the NKZ first floor opened on 15 February 2023 and is staffed around the clock.
**My move:** pick your exit before the train stops, keep your phone away on the stairs and do the slow look around in daylight.
